classification.difficultyReason: Find a fractional side length and combine the three sides that require fencing.

content.prompt:
A rectangular garden uses a straight river bank as its longer side. The other sides are fenced.

If the longer side is 25 m, and the shorter side is $\frac{1}{3}$ of the longer side, what is the total length of fencing material?

answer.worked:
The whole is the 25 m longer side. Three equal parts total 25 m, so one part is the shorter side.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Shorter side}&=25\div3\\\text{Shorter side}&=\frac{25}{3}\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

Only one longer side and the two shorter sides need fencing.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Fencing length}&=25+2\times\frac{25}{3}\\\text{Fencing length}&=\frac{125}{3}\\\text{Fencing length}&=41\frac{2}{3}\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
